title: NADRA Imposes Strict Penalties for Unauthorized Logo and Name Use
excerpt: The National Database and Registration Authority has announced severe punishments for unauthorized use of its name, logo, and emblem.
body_html:
The National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA) has introduced strict penalties for individuals and entities that use its name, logo, or emblem without official permission.

Under the new measures, unauthorized use of these identifiers will lead to severe legal consequences, including prison sentences and financial fines. The authority aims to prevent fraudulent activities and protect the public from entities falsely representing the organization.
